name: rhd
description: Read-only access to your own Robinhood net worth, positions, activity and tax documents, through the open-source rhd CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your Robinhood accounts: net worth and what you hold, what happened over a period (stock trades, dividends, cash interest), and which statements and tax forms exist. Three read-only tools, robinhood_portfolio, robinhood_activity and robinhood_documents; nothing can trade, transfer or change your account. Values cover cash and stocks/ETFs; options and crypto are not included. The extension asks for no password: Robinhood sign-in is through a browser, so first install the rhd CLI and run `rhd auth login --browser` in a terminal. That stores the session in your OS keychain, and the bundled rhd reads it from there and refreshes it in place. With several login profiles, it uses the default one (`rhd profiles use <NAME>`). On macOS the first call asks for keychain access; choose Always Allow. Unofficial; not affiliated with Robinhood Markets.

tools.name: robinhood_portfolio
tools.description: Net worth, each account's total, and the stock positions held.

tools.name: robinhood_activity
tools.description: Activity over a date range: executed stock trades, dividends and cash interest.

tools.name: robinhood_documents
tools.description: Tax forms, statements and trade confirmations on file (listed, not downloaded).
